title: Italian Haloumi Schnitzel
subtitle: with Shoestring Fries and Cabbage Salad
description: Craving a dinner that’s delightfully delish and easy to get on the table? We’re on a mission to make cooking more fun, extra yum and even simpler – this recipe, packed with quality fresh ingredients, is all that and more. Get cooking!

steps.text: Bake fries: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line a large oven tray with baking paper. Peel the potatoes, then cut into matchsticks (see Kitchen hack). Put the potato on the lined tray. Drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil, scatter with 1 tsp Italian seasoning, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Bake, turning halfway, for 25-30 mins until golden.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, drain the haloumi and dry on paper towel, then cut in half horizontally to form 2 schnitzels. Whisk 1 egg in a shallow bowl. Combine the breadcrumbs and remaining Italian seasoning in a separate shallow bowl. Put 1 tbs plain flour in a third bowl.

Pan-fry schnitzels: Dust the haloumi with the flour, shake off the excess, then dip in the egg and coat in the breadcrumb mixture. Heat 1½ tbs olive oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the haloumi schnitzels for 2-3 mins each side until golden and cooked through. Remove from the pan and drain on paper towel. Season with salt and pepper.

Make cabbage salad: While the haloumi schnitzels are cooking, put 2 tbs mayonnaise and 1½ tsp white wine vinegar in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper and whisk to combine. Thinly slice the cabbage with a sharp knife or mandoline. Thinly slice the cucumber. Add the cabbage and cucumber to the dressing and toss to coat.
Serve up: Divide the haloumi schnitzels, cabbage salad and fries among plates and enjoy!
Kitchen hack: Here's an easy way to cut the potatoes into matchsticks: thinly slice lengthwise, then stack the slices and cut into matchsticks.
